title: Ender Mailbox
description:
The Ender Mailbox is used to send and receive Ender Letters.

To send a letter, hold a finished Ender Letter (with a receiver set) and shift right click on any Ender Mailbox, yours or someone else's. If the receiver has never joined the server, the letter is not sent and you keep it. If the receiver's inbox is full, the letter is rejected.

Whoever places an Ender Mailbox becomes its owner. Letters you receive show up in every Ender Mailbox you placed yourself: right click one to open its "Incoming Mail" window with the 9 inbox slots. Only the owner can open a mailbox. A mailbox starts to glow when it holds mail for its owner, with up to 10 seconds delay.

The Ender Mailbox needs free space above it.

Mailboxes work across dimensions: a letter sent from one dimension can be received in another.
